Latest results: detection rate, false positive rate and words recognized
Development split, 227 injection and 223 benign images, default thresholds: d1 45, Clef-Flash 8, all other detectors 80; d1 and Clef-Flash also check sentence windows. Cloud: Mistral OCR + Jev: detection rate 81.5%, false positive rate 0.4%, words recognized 84.6%; Mistral OCR + GPT-6 Luna: detection rate 85.0%, false positive rate 4.5%, words recognized 84.6%; GPT-6 Luna + GPT-6 Luna: detection rate 83.3%, false positive rate 4.5%, words recognized 84.8%; GPT-6 Luna + Jev: detection rate 78.9%, false positive rate 1.3%, words recognized 86.3%; Cloud Vision + GPT-6 Luna (default): detection rate 78.4%, false positive rate 3.6%, words recognized 88.1%; Cloud Vision + Jev: detection rate 74.0%, false positive rate 0.9%, words recognized 88.1%. Local: Quality + Clef-Flash (default): detection rate 56.8%, false positive rate 4.0%, words recognized 77.0%; Quality + Prompt Guard 2: detection rate 19.4%, false positive rate 1.8%, words recognized 77.0%; Balanced + d1: detection rate 45.4%, false positive rate 2.2%, words recognized 72.3%; Balanced + Prompt Guard 2: detection rate 16.7%, false positive rate 1.8%, words recognized 72.3%; Speed + d1: detection rate 43.2%, false positive rate 2.2%, words recognized 70.0%; Speed + Prompt Guard 2: detection rate 18.5%, false positive rate 2.2%, words recognized 70.0%.
